title: Allow incoming traffic on a specific port
summary: Configure UFW to allow incoming connections to a specific port. You can add a comment to identify the service running on that port.

steps.explain: Allow incoming traffic on a specific port and add a comment for clarity.

placeholders.name: SERVICE
placeholders.description: A short name for the service running on this port.

rollback.explain: Delete the rule by its number. First, find the number using 'sudo ufw status numbered'.

placeholders.name: RULE_NUMBER
placeholders.description: The index number of the rule to delete.

warnings: Opening ports exposes services to the network. Ensure the service is secure and necessary.
